title: Variance of Discrete Data
author: 3iGR44tcGMnRnhEYm
chapter_outcomes: Calculate and use the mean and standard deviation of a set of data (including grouped data) either from the data itself or from given totals $\sum x$ and $\sum x^2$ , or coded totals $\sum (x-a)$ and $\sum (x-a)^2$ , and use such totals in solving problems which may involve up to two data sets.
